definitions.gloss: reason; principle; logic; what is right
definitions.explanation: The underlying reason or principle that makes something right or natural. A formal word that appears mostly in set phrases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一理|いちり}ある→一理ある：15122_ichiriaru⟧。
examples.english: There's something in what he says, too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理|り}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆|さか}らわ→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧ず、⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live in step with the seasons rather than against the order of nature.

notes:
Rarely used alone outside set phrases and compounds.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {理|り}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かなう: to be reasonable, to make sense
- ⟦{一理|いちり}ある→一理ある：15122_ichiriaru⟧: to have a point
- {理|り}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧: a matter of course
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理|り}: the law of nature

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{道理|どうり}→道理：10400_douri⟧: reason, sense — everyday equivalent
- ⟦{理屈|りくつ}→理屈：02513_rikutsu⟧: logic, argument — often with a hint of mere theorizing
- ⟦{利|り}→利：29142_ri⟧: same reading — advantage, profit
